note: The founder charter (CHARTER-01): the boundaries the owner sets once; inside them the organisation decides and acts by itself. Apply with: npm run charter -- set docs/policies/founder-charter.json --reason "...". Change any number before applying. Never automatic, whatever this says: the hard limits in .env (order, exposure, realised loss), permissions, departments, retirement, and real money. Amounts are in paise (100 paise = Rs 1).
